name: Historic Monuments Zone of Tlacotalpan
description: Tlacotalpan is a small river port in Veracruz, Mexico, founded in 1550 on the banks of the Papaloapan River. Its wide streets are lined with arcaded houses painted in a riot of colours and styles, and shaded by mature trees and leafy gardens. Once a busy trading hub until the railways took over, it now draws visitors for its colonial charm and the annual Candlemas festival.
